_doc: Demo44 thermal plan (firmware DUAL: LC LH RC RH independent; DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §3). Data for the build stage (main.js EVENTS / PLACE_AMB) and for scripts/thermal_plan.py (simulates the default story path with the real voice loudness → project/thermal_preview.csv + checks). az in degrees: 0 = front, -90 = LEFT ear, +90 = RIGHT ear (ear weights wL = 1 - 1.2·max(0, sin az), wR = 1 - 1.2·max(0, -sin az)). kind warm / cool, level 0-1 (warm ≤ 0.9, cool ≤ 1). 'set' = ambient sources that stay until the next 'set' (by name; level 0 removes); 'pulse' = a source that rises, holds 'hold' s and fades with 'fade' s; 'sweep' = a moving source from az0 to az1 over 'secs'. Every source names its physical cause, visible on screen. Magic light (summoning circle, the return circle) has NO temperature (world rule card).

@circle.why: the summoning circle flashes: light only, no temperature (rule card)

@hall.why: stone hall: a cold draught along the floor + two iron braziers left and right

@lean_left.why: Tsubaki leans to your left ear (her voice does the warming)

@takeoff.why: the broom lifts off: head wind grows with speed

@dive.why: the dive at full speed (hold on): the cold PEAK, both ears

@turn_left.why: sharp left turn: the wind swings from your left ear across to your right

@descend.why: slowing down to land: wind drops

@lab.why: workshop: brick furnace + cauldron fire on the RIGHT, iron cold cabinet with frost on the LEFT (left cool / right warm)

@flare.why: a pinch of fire-salamander scale: the furnace flame flares up in front-right (the HEAT peak, real fire)

@mug_right.why: the hot cocoa mug pressed to your RIGHT cheek

@blow_right.why: silent moment: she takes the mug away and blows on your right cheek — right ear warm → cool in < 1 s (fast switch)

@sip.why: you drink: the mug in front of your face

@tower.why: tower salon: fireplace on the LEFT, open window to the night on the RIGHT

@crystal_show.why: FIRST appearance of ice magic, slowly: one real ice crystal forms in her palm in front of you

@orbit.why: ice crystals circle your head once (360°, real ice); passing the LEFT ear they meet the fireplace = cool + warm on the same ear

@into_glass.why: the crystals drop into your glass and melt away

@lean_right.why: Luna leans to your RIGHT ear, beside the open window (warm voice + cool night air on the same ear)

@sunrise.why: dawn on the tower: the sun rises in front, morning air, the fire burned down to embers

@cloak.why: (keep talking) Luna's cloak around you on the broom: wind cut, cloth warm on the left

showcase.fast_switch: lab: @mug_right (right warm 0.6) → @blow_right (right cool 0.75, mug gone) in a silent moment (no line between c08 and c09)
showcase.peak: sky: @dive wind cool 0.92 both ears (hold); lab: @flare warm 0.88 front-right
showcase.direction: lab: cabinet LEFT cool / furnace RIGHT warm; sky: @turn_left sweep left → right; tower: fire left / night right
showcase.same_ear_dual: tower: @orbit passes the LEFT ear while the fireplace warms it; l10 at the RIGHT ear: warm voice + cool night air; hall t07 left-ear whisper over the stone draught
